_contract: The Phase-C2 INSTANCE data the authorization assembler needs: which stage the run layout places attempts under, which money figures a mis-priced session is refused against, and what the two stage conditions say. AUTHORIZES NOTHING: this is configuration, not a grant.
_why_this_is_short: C1's equivalent carries a battery identity, a scoring-equivalence verdict, a C0 protocol hash, a recovery recipe and a whole execution package. C2 Search-1 trains nothing, scores no battery and runs no probes, so none of that has a C2 meaning. The per-attempt money, the retry rule and the runtime envelopes live in the attempt's GRANT, where a maintainer writes them, rather than being restated here in a second place that could disagree.
_stage_id_meaning: Which PIPELINE STAGE this experiment belongs to, DECLARED rather than inferred. C2 is Stage 1 -- projection and structural initialization: it searches over initialization operator compositions and ranks them on a cheap step-0 metric. The PHASE is C, carried by experiment_id 'phase_c2'; the ATTEMPT is the run_id. Consumed by scripts/experiments/run_layout.py to place runs at logs/stages/stage-1/phase_c2/runs/<run_id>/.

grant_contract._field_split: STATED is what only a person can say. VERIFIED is the other half of C2's contract and is not C1's: a C2 grant records the identities the maintainer approved against, inside bound_identities_the_issuer_must_reproduce, and the issuer RE-DERIVES every one of them and refuses on any disagreement. C1 refuses a grant that asserts a derived field at all; C2 accepts the assertion and checks it, which is why the field names below are verified rather than derived. An asserted identity is never trusted, and an identity the issuer does not know how to derive is a refusal.

money._why: a C2 grant records the project's budget position in one nested block rather than as two loose top-level numbers. The generic cap arithmetic in src/aadistill/governance/grant.py takes a FLAT mapping with configurable field names, so the assembler reads this block and hands it the two figures. Naming the block here rather than in code is what keeps the mechanism free of C2's document shape.

accepted_pricing._why_restated: so a mis-priced session is REFUSED rather than mirrored. A ceiling that only echoes its source is not an independent check, and this is the last place a mis-priced session can be stopped before an authorization exists. These are the figures of the 2026-09-15 maintainer approval; the maintainer forbade rounding the ceiling upward and forbade substituting C1's $15.1475, which belongs to a different package and a different experiment.

_authorized_stages_meaning: The two indices of C2_STAGES: 0 is bind_identities, 1 is search_and_baseline. Integers because that is the shape PhaseAAuthorization carries; the names are in the session contract the plan hash covers.

stage_conditions.bind_identities: every identity is verified BEFORE anything expensive: the image digest, the live executable digest, the teacher revision, both calibration mixtures by spec and by content hash, the configured space, and the frozen baseline construction. A disagreement stops the session at approximately $0 rather than after the first level of the beam.
stage_conditions.search_and_baseline: the beam search runs inside its own envelope, which excludes the baseline rebuild reserve; the ranking is committed the instant it exists rather than at closeout; and the baseline B is resolved exactly once -- searched if the beam re-derived it, rebuilt through the frozen C1 fixed path if not. Once the beam search has BEGUN, a failure is not retried: preserve, tear down, reconcile, report.
stage_conditions.interpretation: the state_eval ranking is hypothesis-generation evidence. A search winner is not a demonstrated initialization improvement, behavioural confirmation is a separately authorized experiment, and Search-2 is not reachable from this session.

one_use: ONE grant, ONE issuance, ONE launcher session. A failure is this session's result; a new session always uses a complete new one-use chain under a new attempt identity and never reuses a consumed one. An invocation that aborts before the beam search begins consumed its chain even at $0.
